title: Sea Castle - Vacation Rental in Panama City Beach,FL | 30a Escapes
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… "Sea Castle," a stunning Gulf Front mansion in West Panama City Beach, minutes from 30A. This luxurious 7,275 sq ft retreat features 9 bedrooms, 9+ bathrooms, and sleeps up to 36 guests. Enjoy a private pool, hot tub, direct beach access, expansive Gulf views, a professional chef's kitchen with scenic dining for the entire group! Perfect for hosting family reunions, large gatherings, and milestone celebrations. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Breathtaking Gulf-front retreat with panoramic ocean views guaranteed to leave your group in aweAccommodates up to 40 guests with 9 luxurious bedrooms, including 2 incredible Gulf-front Primary Suites and custom-designed Queen-size Bunk rooms, perfect for large groupsGourmet chef’s kitchen featuring dual high-end appliances and seating for all 36 guests, ideal for group diningExclusive oceanfront amenities: Private heated pool and hot tub, Direct private beach access for easy enjoyment, 2,000+ sq ft pool deck with ample lounging and seatingEntertainment for everyone: Game room with pool table, foosball, arcade games, and triple mounted TVsComplimentary daily beach setup: 8 beach chairs and 4 umbrellas for ultimate convenience 365 days a year!Elevator access to all 4 floors for easy mobilityOnly 4 miles to Rosemary Beach and 30A for local exploration and activitiesEager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐"Amazing rental!! Our group of 23 had plenty of space, and the location is top-notch!!" – Tessa M.⭐"Breathtaking! The house is stunning, the beach views are incredible, and everything was perfect for our group of 24." – Elaine H.⭐"Beautiful home with all the bells and whistles. We celebrated a milestone birthday here, and the whole group loved it!" – Zain G.*** LIVING AREAS ***Ground-Floor Entertainment & Game Room Get ready for nonstop fun on the ground floor, designed as the ultimate entertainment hub for all ages. This vibrant space offers everything you need for an unforgettable game night, featuring a pool table, foosball, classic arcade games, and three wall-mounted TVs for an immersive experience.Enjoy a pool table and foosball for endless entertainmentRelive the nostalgia with classic arcade gamesCatch every moment with triple wall-mounted TVsA kitchenette and half bath for maximum convenienceSecond-Floor Main Living AreaThe second-floor living space is where elegance meets comfort. With its open-concept design, this area invites guests to relax together while enjoying breathtaking Gulf views.Open-concept living area with expansive Gulf viewsCozy fireplace for relaxing eveningsSmart TVs for entertainmentPlush seating for group gatheringsDirect access to a balcony with more stunning views*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Sea Castle's chef-designed kitchen is a culinary masterpiece, ideal for cooking together or hosting an elegant private chef's dinner.Gourmet kitchen with Wolf range, Sub-Zero refrigerator, and dual ovensWine fridge and dedicated coffee stations for added indulgenceTwo dining tables accommodating 16 guests, plus bar seating for 10Outdoor balcony dining area with seating for 10, perfect for al fresco meals*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Experience unparalleled outdoor living at Sea Castle. The home’s oversized Gulf-front deck includes ample lounging and dining space, plus a private beach boardwalk leading straight to powdery white sands.Private pool and hot tub with Gulf viewsGrilling area with Green Egg on the pool deckMultiple oceanfront balconies and lounge areasOutdoor shower and direct beach access via private boardwalk*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor:Bunk Room (R) - Queen-over-queen bunks with an en suite bath, single vanity, and glass-enclosed showerBunk Room (L) - Queen-over-queen bunks with an en suite bath featuring dual sinks and showerHalf Bathroom - Conveniently located for easy access from game room and pool deck2nd Floor:King Guest Room - King bed with private en suite and balcony access facing the front of the houseBunk Room - Queen-over-queen bunks with an en suite, equipped with dual sinks and shower3rd Floor:King Primary Suite - King bed with killer Gulf views, private balcony, kitchenette, and spa-inspired en suite with soaking tub and rain showerKing Guest Room - King bed with en suite featuring dual sinks and soaking tubBunk Room - Queen-over-queen bunk with an en suite and walk-in shower4th Floor:King Primary Suite - King bed with Gulf views, private balcony, coffee bar, and elegant en suite with soaking tubBunk Room - 3 sets of Queen-over-queen bunks adorned with basketball hoop, double vanity, and an en suite featuring multiple showers and vanities (Sleeps 12)*** ADDITIONAL AMENITIES ***Dedicated Workspace - Conveniently located on the 4th floor, perfect for remote work or studyElevator - Access all floors with easeSmart TVs - Every room is equipped with a smart TV for streaming and entertainmentFully Equipped Laundry Room - Includes washer, dryer, and ample space for all your laundry needs*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Steps from Panama City Beach4-minute drive to Camp Helen State Park9 minutes to Rosemary Beach shopping and dining*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independently.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentPools can only be heated between the dates of September 1st - April 30th.Beach chair setup included in rental year-round (8 chairs and 4 umbrellas)*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 295780STRO #: 39093
